result.title: Optimizing Multi-Tier Intermediation in Programmatic Advertising: A DAG-Based Mechanism for Supply Path Optimization
result.summary: Digital programmatic advertising operates through complex, multi-hop supply chains. The opacity of these intermediary networks leads to significant efficiency losses, often referred to as the ``ad-tech tax.'' While current industry practices utilize heuristic Supply Path Optimization (SPO) to trim inefficient routes, they fail to optimize the equilibrium of the entire network. This paper extends previous work on Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) intermediation models by applying them to traceable programmatic supply chains mapped via the OpenRTB SupplyChain object. We introduce multi-attribute utility functions and Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) to account for substitutable routing (OR nodes) and percentage-based fee structures. Furthermore, we outline a computational methodology and experimental framework using public \texttt{schain} and \texttt{sellers.json} data to benchmark optimal Nash social welfare against current uncoordinated market outcomes.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究程序化广告多层级供应链中的中介优化问题，基于 DAG 模型、多属性效用函数与 MILP 建模可替代路由和按比例收费结构，并给出基于 schain/sellers.json 的评测框架。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究主题为广告供应链机制设计与市场均衡优化，与 latent visual reasoning 的表示、状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策无实质联系，其中的 DAG 与 MILP 仅为广告路由建模工具，未提供可核查的借鉴线索。
